title: UAP fly around government teams at events while the teams do not notice

tellings.quote: We are arriving in the first day, and around their west fly NAYA, and They have no idea.

plain: A man named James Valor, from a startup called Skywatcher that tries to call up UFOs, says UAP, short for unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs, fly around government teams at test events while the teams have no idea. He tells Michels he has seen it himself, from the first day his group arrives. If true, the objects would be close by and still going unnoticed by the people sent to look for them.
